title: NTC 2018 reinforced-concrete ULS uniaxial N-M interaction domain

sourceFiles.coverage: Adds the source-compatible nValues, pointCount, and includeOppositeCurvature inputs used by the uniaxial domain workflow.
Dispatches uls-uniaxial-domain in addition to the previously migrated resistance workflow.
Application metadata now declares the uniaxial resistance and interaction-domain modes.
Reuses the resolved flexure-and-axial-force record introduced by slice 0004.

independentValidation.method: comparison of the NEd = -800000 N domain point with the independently integrated and bisected continuous-section reference established by slice 0004
independentValidation.fixture: 300 mm by 500 mm C25/30 section with four 20 mm B450C bars
independentValidation.additionalCheck: The automatic tension and capped-compression endpoints are independently reconstructed from As fyd and -(0.8 Ac fcd + As fyd), and the 21-point spacing is checked.

parityDifferences: For uls-uniaxial-domain with assigned axial-force values, the serialized verification result and numerical output have no known parity differences.
The TypeScript verifier still returns not-implemented for uls-biaxial-domain, service-stress, and moment-curvature until those workflows are migrated.
The application manifest advertises only the currently implemented NTC 2018 uniaxial scope instead of the broader JavaScript application scope.
engineeringFunctionality: Usable NTC 2018 ULS uniaxial reinforced-concrete N-M interaction-domain generation with assigned or automatically sampled axial-force levels and both curvature signs. The result is a resistance domain, not a direct demand-containment verification, and it is not a biaxial, serviceability, shear, torsion, detailing, member, or conformity verifier.
